    Innovation Lab

    Where the network builds its own companies.

    The Innovation Lab incubates ventures that fix what holds a market back. Each one starts with a partner who knows the problem first-hand. Current work spans the art market, personal finance, personal AI and family heritage.

    An ecosystem for the people and projects that move culture forward.

    One Away Partners was founded in 2019 between Paris and San Francisco. It works at the meeting point of art, technology and finance, and brings together a network of partners who each lead their own ventures.

    Membership is by invitation. Partners are introduced by the founding group, and each project on the atlas is led by someone inside the network.

    ArtMonumental public works, placement and collector advisory.
    TechnologyTools that modernise how art and family knowledge are recorded and shared.
    CapitalAccess for partners to the investment vehicles behind each project.
